entries.control_question: Can a candidate be replayed from the same frozen base and accepted without trusting the worker that produced it?
implemented_invariants: accepted output is separate from execution completion
candidate state and restoration proofs are sealed
first divergence is preserved
entries.next_design_transaction: Package the full physical transaction for artifact-only replay by an external acceptor without repository access.
open_invariants: artifact-only external replay across a measured physical run

entries.control_question: Can a provider be removed without changing workload identity, acceptance, fallback, publication, or historical custody?
implemented_invariants: provider manifests cannot claim architectural authority
offers and acknowledged submissions are separate states
dependency mode is commodity_only
entries.next_design_transaction: Ingest the first acknowledged external host or cartridge submission and replace one reference endpoint without changing acceptance.

entries.control_question: Does every ambiguous, missing, refused, faulted, unmeasured, and accepted condition retain a distinct terminal receipt?
implemented_invariants: MMIO ambiguity refuses closed
provider and EVP blockers are explicit
physical claims remain false when evidence is absent
entries.next_design_transaction: Exercise facility denial, fabrication failure, instrument dropout, and physical drift as distinct negative-space fixtures.
open_invariants: institutional and physical failure fixtures beyond software refusal

entries.control_question: Can source, build, execution, measurement, acceptance, and supersession be reconstructed after the original actor disappears?
implemented_invariants: registry, workload, target, consist, EVP, and pylon artifacts are SHA-256 sealed
source and public artifact identities are retained
programme failure remains a registry record
entries.next_design_transaction: Emit an in-toto or equivalent source-to-GDS-to-measurement succession chain and reconstruct it from an isolated audit bundle.
open_invariants: artifact-only reconstruction after tool and facility removal

entries.control_question: Can two substrate implementations preserve descriptor, lifecycle, state, fallback, and receipt behavior behind one binding?
implemented_invariants: physical-compute-mmio/v1 is the portable floor
descriptor and capability surfaces are typed
software fallback is mandatory
Xphys cannot change evidence or acceptance
entries.next_design_transaction: Replace the loopback reference with an RC or thermal physical cartridge while preserving the exact host transaction.

entries.control_question: Does every physical candidate retain a public reference twin under identical accepted work?
implemented_invariants: reference RC and thermal cartridges execute through the shared runtime
physical assay compares raw and transformed trajectories
provider hitches require software fallback
entries.next_design_transaction: Run one measured physical cartridge and its software twin under the same accepted workload and emit first model-to-device divergence.

entries.control_question: Are command, busy, reset, refusal, fault, receipt, and accepted-output states mutually explicit across implementations?
implemented_invariants: complete reset, load, evolve, read, and capture surface
ambiguous commands refuse
done, refused, and fault outcomes are exclusive
reset and receipt behavior are tested
entries.next_design_transaction: Execute the same lifecycle in Chipyard RTL and the first physical cartridge, including timeout and resolver fault paths.

entries.control_question: Are state, entropy, environment, calibration, clocks, power, and accepted output aligned to the same causal interval?
implemented_invariants: exact, trace-replay, and distributional determinism are separate
entropy traces and environment digests are first-class
EVP binds calibration, environment, instruments, and time
entries.next_design_transaction: Join instrument clocks, physical entropy, environment, calibration, power, and accepted output in one measured execution trace.

entries.control_question: Can accepted semantics survive portable representation, target lowering, and execution across two backends?
implemented_invariants: instruction information effects precede lowering
structured and memory-irregular semantic lowerings exist
target artifacts remain bound to accepted output
entries.next_design_transaction: Lower one composite FAMBS workload through CIRCT or Calyx and Chipyard, then prove source, IR, RTL, and target parity.

entries.control_question: Which measured behavior replaces each model tier, and where does the first fidelity divergence occur?
implemented_invariants: reference, simulated, and measured evidence classes are distinct
model-only execution cannot make physical claims
held-out assay retains source and response separation
entries.next_design_transaction: Execute an ideal, nonideal, calibrated, and measured RC or stochastic-device staircase with first-divergence receipts.

entries.control_question: Does the physical response improve held-out accepted work beyond raw sensing after readout and acquisition costs are included?
implemented_invariants: raw stimulus and substrate response use the same readout
held-out compute gain is explicit
software fallback cannot become a physical-compute claim
entries.next_design_transaction: Acquire measured nonfallback episodes from an environmental, RC, oscillator, or stochastic substrate and repeat the held-out assay with full acquisition cost.

entries.control_question: Does the receipt include every component required to deliver the accepted result?
implemented_invariants: component, subsystem, and complete-system scopes are distinct
boundary exclusions block complete-system qualification
energy, volume, and time share the accepted-work interval
entries.next_design_transaction: Measure host, memory, cartridge, interconnect, conversion, sensing, readout, package, and cooling for one accepted workload.

entries.control_question: For the same accepted work, boundary, and environment, does the candidate Pareto-dominate a sealed baseline?
implemented_invariants: EVP is a vector rather than a scalar score
energy origins and returns remain separate
baseline comparability and Pareto admission are enforced
entries.next_design_transaction: Produce the first measured candidate and sealed baseline for identical accepted work, complete boundary, and environment.

entries.control_question: Can endpoints and transports be replaced independently while preserving lifecycle, opaque state, errors, and transfer receipts?
implemented_invariants: host and cartridge are separately replaceable

entries.next_design_transaction: Execute the generated bridge and cartridge link in Chipyard RTL, then substitute one host and one physical endpoint independently.

entries.control_question: Which communication, synchronization, refresh, utilization, and failure cost appears at each new scale seam?
implemented_invariants: scale seams are represented as distinct registry gaps and pylons
chiplet, photonic, neuromorphic, and rack witnesses share one design constraint
entries.next_design_transaction: Build a tile-to-die-to-package-to-rack traffic and EVP model for one accepted workload and measure each incremental seam.

implemented_invariants: remote testbeds, fabrication facilities, and programmes are mapped to bounded transactions

entries.control_question: Which recovery strategy preserves the most accepted work under the same state, failure, and energy trace?

implemented_invariants: 73 records resolve to official sources, assets, gaps, first transactions, and receipts
